_comment: Entries for the Live NFO ticker. `closesOn` is the ISO date the offer closes, INCLUSIVE — an offer open 'to 30th January' is open ON the 30th and gone on the 31st. It is effectively REQUIRED: isOpenNfo() returns false for any entry without one, so an entry with no `closesOn` never renders however it is flagged, because an offer with no stated end is not evidence that it is open. `active: true` is no longer sufficient on its own — it is only the hand-set 'not withdrawn' flag, and it was `active` with no expiry at all that kept the three January 2026 windows below on screen beside a pulsing 'Live NFO' label until September 2026. Closed offers stay in this file with `active: false` and their real `closesOn` rather than being deleted, so the record survives and the date filter is visibly the thing holding them off the page. Titles here state a day and a month but no year: read the year from the entry's own `date`, since an NFO is announced before its window opens — all three below were posted in Nov/Dec 2025, so their 'January' is the first January after that, 2026. When a year is genuinely ambiguous take the LATEST plausible reading and check it against today: if it is already past the offer is closed either way; if it lands in the future, confirm the real window from the AMC before setting `active`. This first element carries no `active` and no `closesOn`, so the same fail-closed rule makes it unrenderable — it is a comment, not an offer.
